title: Autumn Italian Apple Strata
description: A hearty, garlicky Italian-inspired strata filled with apples and topped with a creamy stracciatella.

ingredients.name: apples
ingredients.notes: varieties like honeycrisp or fuji work well

instructions: Cube the bread and layer it in a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Mix the minced garlic with the softened stracciatella and spread it over the bread.
Peel and slice the apples, then layer them over the stracciatella mixture.
In a separate bowl, beat the eggs and mix in the grated parmesan cheese.
Pour the egg mixture over the apple layer and smooth out the top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the top is golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5-10 minutes before serving.
